verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Keyboard shortcuts' help article, so it ships its own shortcut support, but the pack contains only the article title and nothing on how comprehensive the shortcuts are. One community user reports the interface was 'a ton faster' than ProtonMail, which gives weak, anecdotal support for the speed claim. Missing for 10: any evidence of a command palette, documentation of shortcut coverage or depth, and benchmark or hands-on evidence that the web interface never makes users wait.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
